# Edge cases: zoom with splits, kills and selects; nested cells collapsing; percentages; full
# splits against a root of the same and the other type; the smallest panes.
new 100x30
split %0 -h
split %1 -v
split %2 -h
zoom %1
split %1 -v
zoom %0
kill %4
zoom %3
select %0
zoom %2
layout $3
kill %3
kill %2
split %0 -v -f -l 25%
split %5 -h -f -b -l 10%
split %6 -v -f -b
resize %0 -x 50%
resize %7 -y 20%
resize %0 -L 0
split %6 -v -l 0
resize %6 -U 100
kill %6
kill %7
kill %0
kill %8
window 10x5
split %5 -h
split %9 -h
split %10 -h
split %11 -h
split %5 -v
split %13 -v
window 3x3
window 1x1
window 100x30
border bottom
split %9 -v
split %1 -v -b
resize %10 -y 5
resize %1 -y 3
zoom %9
window 90x20
kill %10
